title: Cloud-native AI video processing platform
description: Architected and deployed a cloud-native AI video processing platform on Azure App Service with asynchronous processing using Azure Functions and Azure Service Bus for scalable, event-driven workflows.
Designed secure video ingestion and storage using Azure Blob Storage with lifecycle policies to optimize storage cost.
Implemented semantic vector search using Azure AI Search (vector indexing + custom scoring profiles) to enable low-latency contextual retrieval across large transcript datasets.
Integrated Azure OpenAI Service for transcription and summarization pipelines with structured output validation.

title: DevTools API Insight
description: Developed API Insight, a Chrome DevTools extension for advanced network traffic capture, analysis, and debugging with intelligent session auto-segmentation and real-time statistics.
Engineered advanced filtering capabilities to eliminate framework noise, static assets, third-party analytics, and preflight requests—dramatically improving API debugging efficiency.
Implemented deep content inspection with secure full-height previews for HTML, images, and PDFs embedded within JSON responses.
Built an instant request replay engine allowing modification of methods, headers, and payloads with automatic header sanitization to prevent CORS and browser-level errors.

title: Real Time Chat Application
description: Built a real-time chat application with React.js and Firebase, focusing on simple, reliable messaging.
Enabled real-time communication using Firebase Realtime Database, so messages are instantly sent and received.
Added Google Authentication to make login easy and secure for users.
Restricted access so only logged-in users can join the chat room, keeping the conversation private.
Used Cloud Firestore to store messages, ensuring they are saved and can be accessed anytime.
